_template_meta.purpose: Drop-in baseline for .claude/settings.json that enforces this fork's security policy at the harness level. Copy to <your-project>/.claude/settings.json (or merge with your existing file) before letting the agent run.
_template_meta.codex_cli_note: Codex CLI authentication is via 'codex login' (ChatGPT OAuth). The OPENAI_API_KEY env var is NEVER set in this file or in the agent harness — Codex stores its own token in ~/.codex. If your team policy requires inspectable creds, run codex with OPENAI_API_KEY exported only in the calling shell, not here.
